name: Deliverance
source:
Rosca. Leola. Nic. Oberon.

Four blind shadows chasing down the light the only way they know how. In the end, there's only damnation or deliverance.

Then again, maybe they're the same damn thing.

[From [url=https://12amstatic.itch.io/deliverance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗斯卡。莱奥拉。尼克。奥布朗。

四个盲目的影子以他们唯一知道的方式追逐着光芒。最终，只有诅咒或解脱。

话又说回来，也许他们是同一个该死的东西。

[来自[url=https://12amstatic.itch.io/deliverance]Itch.io[/url]]
